s01.t03: É um passo da tua história.
s01.t05: é um passo da tua história
s01.t10: Campaign concept, copy, packaging, film scripts, podcast, outdoor, retail and events

s02.t03: How does a brand that is almost a century old talk to people who never lived its history?
s02.t04: The brand of the old days reinvented itself. So did its buyers: they shop online and meet brands there first.
s02.t06: Know the legacy and keep it alive. They also hold the buying power.
s02.t08: Nostalgic for things they never had.
s02.t10: Ready to go past tradition altogether.

s03.t03: Tradition is passed from hand to hand.
s03.t07: A tradição é uma herança passada entre mãos, mas que se calça nos pés.

s04.t02: Tudo pode mudar. Mas há coisas que caminham sempre connosco.
s04.t03: Everything can change. Some things always walk with us.
s04.t04: The young reach Sanjo through parents and grandparents. The legacy is real, but you wear it, and it takes you somewhere new.

s05.t09: A biscuit tin, with sneakers in it
s05.t10: The shoebox borrows from another piece of Portuguese memory: the blue metal biscuit tin that came from a grandparent's hands. Nostalgia is a card few brands can play. A brand this old can.
s05.t13: A young woman scrolls through family photos and finds the same shoes in every decade. Then a black-and-white victory, and a sneaker thrown so high it keeps going.
s05.t16: Real stories that began with a pair of shoes, told with special guests. Plus social formats, the brand site and retailer pages.
s05.t19: Outdoor, one step at a time
s05.t24: A photo studio shaped like a shoebox
s05.t25: Visitors pick an outfit outside, step into the box and leave with a professional portrait in Sanjo. The pictures go out on their own feeds.
s05.t27: The same step, everywhere you walk
s05.t28: Online sales keep growing. The street still gives a brand what a screen cannot: something to stand in front of.

s06.t01: Não é um passo em falso. Não é um passo maior que a perna.
s06.t03: Not a false step. Not a step too far. The next step.
